title: Anonymous accounts and email magic-link auth via Cognito & SES
description:
Scope
- Pivot to Cognito Hosted UI passwordless (email OTP). Cognito sends emails via its integration; no backend SES; no app-owned magic links.
- Client initiates OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE to Cognito Hosted UI; Cognito redirects to the client app with code; client calls backend to exchange the code for tokens.
- Maintain anonymous account creation. Maintain UserProfile records and identity links in DynamoDB (COGNITO + EMAIL). Telegram remains unchanged.
- Enforce email uniqueness both in Cognito (alias) and application-level identities.

Endpoints
1) POST /auth/oauth2/exchange
   - Body: { code: string, redirectUri: string, codeVerifier?: string }.
   - Exchanges authorization code for tokens via Cognito token endpoint (grant_type=authorization_code). Use Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret) if a client secret is configured. Include code_verifier when using PKCE.
   - Returns LoginResultModel (idToken, accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn, tokenType).
   - After exchange, ensure a UserProfile exists and link identities (IdentityProvider.COGNITO by sub; IdentityProvider.EMAIL if available in id token claims).

2) POST /auth/refresh
   - Body: { refreshToken: string }.
   - Exchanges refresh token via Cognito token endpoint (grant_type=refresh_token) and returns LoginResultModel with new id/access tokens.

3) POST /auth/anonymous
   - Creates an anonymous Cognito user (generated username), authenticates (admin/shared backend password if applicable), returns LoginResultModel.
   - Ensures UserProfile exists and links IdentityProvider.COGNITO with providerUserId = Cognito sub.

4) POST /auth/link/email/initiate (JWT protected via Cognito access token)
   - Body: { email: string }.
   - Validates email not linked to another user. Sets/updates Cognito email attribute and calls GetUserAttributeVerificationCode('email') so Cognito sends the verification code via SES.
   - Returns StatusModel { status: 'CODE_SENT' }.

5) POST /auth/link/email/confirm (JWT protected)
   - Body: { code: string }.
   - Calls VerifyUserAttribute('email', code). On success, ensures UserProfile exists and links IdentityProvider.EMAIL (email) and IdentityProvider.COGNITO (sub) in DynamoDB.

Removed endpoints
- POST /auth/login/email/initiate and GET /auth/login/email/confirm.
- GET /auth/link/email/confirm (magic-link based).

Configuration
- Add: cognito.domain (Hosted UI domain). Keep cognito.clientId, cognito.clientSecret (optional), cognito.userPoolId.
- Remove backend SES requirement and magic-link settings. SES remains in Cognito domain only. Make SES_FROM_EMAIL non-required in validation.

Security
- Use PKCE for browser authorize; backend token exchange uses client secret (confidential client) when configured.
- Protected endpoints use Cognito JWT guard (access tokens) with JWKS validation.

Acceptance criteria
- /auth/oauth2/exchange exchanges codes for tokens correctly; /auth/refresh refreshes tokens.
- Anonymous account creation returns tokens and creates profile + identity.
- Email link flows use Cognito verification codes (initiate/confirm) — no backend SES or magic links.
- Magic-link and email modules removed; seed script no longer creates MagicLinkTokens table.
- Swagger docs updated.
- COGNITO_UPDATE.md updated with Hosted UI settings, PKCE, OAuth scopes, and token exchange details.

features.title: Add enums and config scaffolding for email link auth
features.description:
- Add AuthStrategyName.EmailLink = 'emailLink'.
- Extend IdentityProvider with EMAIL.
- Introduce/validate config keys: cognito.userPoolId, cognito.backendPassword, magicLink.expirySeconds, magicLink.baseUrl, ses.fromEmail, PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (for constructing confirmation links). 
- Validate required config at startup with clear errors (e.g., missing backend password or userPoolId).

features.title: SES EmailService
features.description:
- Implement EmailService using AWS SES v3 (SESv2Client).
- API: sendMail({ to, subject, html, text }).
- Config: ses.fromEmail (required), ses.region (defaults to aws.region). Use default AWS credential provider chain.
- Provide minimal email templates for 'login' and 'link' (plain text + simple HTML), with configurable subject prefix.
- Unit tests with a mocked SES client.

features.title: MagicLink token storage (DynamoDB) and service
features.description:
- Add TABLE_MAGIC_LINK_TOKENS constant and DynamoDB repository.
- Schema: tokenHash (PK), purpose ('login'|'link'), email, userId (for 'link'), expiresAt (TTL), usedAt (nullable), createdAt.
- Implement MagicLinkService: generateToken(purpose, email, userId?), hash & store with expiry; validateAndConsume(token) -> returns record or throws if invalid/expired/used.
- Use secure hashing (e.g., HMAC-SHA256 with server key or SHA-256 + per-token random salt stored per record).
- Enforce atomic one-time use with a conditional update (only mark usedAt if not already set), to prevent race conditions.
- Ensure DynamoDB TTL is enabled on 'expiresAt'.
- Build links using PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL and the GET confirmation endpoints.
- Unit tests for generation, validation, expiry, atomic consumption, and one-time use.

features.title: Cognito admin helper service for backend-managed flows
features.description:
- Implement CognitoAdminService wrapping AWS Cognito admin APIs: createUser (or ensure user), setPermanentPassword(shared), findUserByEmail, updateUserEmail(verified), getSubByUsername, adminInitiateAuth (USER_PASSWORD_AUTH), refreshTokens.
- Handle SECRET_HASH computation when client secret is configured.
- Return normalized results (sub, tokens) for use by controllers.
- Unit tests with mocked Cognito client.

features.title: POST /auth/anonymous endpoint
features.description:
- Endpoint: POST /auth/anonymous.
- Flow: generate username 'anon-<uuid or timestamp>', ensure Cognito user exists with shared backend password, initiate auth to get id/access/refresh tokens.
- Ensure a UserProfile exists; link IdentityProvider.COGNITO (providerUserId = sub).
- Response: LoginResultModel (JSON).
- Error handling: surfacing Cognito errors; config validation.
- Tests: happy path and failures.

features.title: POST /auth/login/email/initiate endpoint
features.description:
- Endpoint: POST /auth/login/email/initiate.
- DTO: { email: string } with validation.
- Validations: if email already linked to a user, allow; if not linked, allow (will create on confirm). Optionally cross-check Cognito for conflicts.
- Generate magic link token (purpose='login'), store hashed with expiry, send email via SES with link to GET /auth/login/email/confirm?token=...
- Response: StatusModel { status: 'CODE_SENT' }.
- Tests for rate limiting hooks (if available), validation, and success.

features.title: GET /auth/login/email/confirm endpoint
features.description:
- Endpoint: GET /auth/login/email/confirm?token=...
- Validate and consume token (not used/expired, purpose='login').
- Find or create Cognito user for the email, set email + email_verified=true.
- Ensure UserProfile exists; link IdentityProvider.COGNITO (sub) and IdentityProvider.EMAIL (email).
- Initiate Cognito auth with shared backend password; return LoginResultModel (JSON tokens directly).
- Tests: token invalid/expired/used, happy path, and user creation flow.

features.title: POST /auth/link/email/initiate endpoint (auth required)
features.description:
- Endpoint: POST /auth/link/email/initiate (Authorization: Bearer <token>).
- DTO: { email: string } with validation.
- Validations: email must not be linked to a different user (check identities table and optionally Cognito), else reject.
- Generate magic link token (purpose='link') bound to the requesting user (store userId or Cognito sub); store hashed with expiry; send SES email with GET link.
- Response: StatusModel { status: 'CODE_SENT' }.
- Tests for conflict handling and happy path.

features.title: GET /auth/link/email/confirm endpoint
features.description:
- Endpoint: GET /auth/link/email/confirm?token=...
- Validate and consume token (not used/expired, purpose='link').
- Ensure email is still free; link email to the user encoded in the token.
- Update Cognito user email + email_verified=true for that user.
- Link IdentityProvider.EMAIL in DynamoDB; ensure profile exists.
- Optionally initiate Cognito auth and return LoginResultModel JSON.
- Tests: conflicting email, token used/expired, happy path.

features.title: POST /auth/refresh endpoint
features.description:
- Endpoint: POST /auth/refresh.
- DTO: { refreshToken: string, username?: string, idToken?: string }.
- Exchanges refresh token for new id/access tokens via Cognito. If SECRET_HASH is required by the app client, accept username or derive it from idToken ('cognito:username').
- Response: LoginResultModel with new id/access tokens; refresh token typically unchanged.
- Tests: with and without client secret, invalid refresh token cases.

features.title: DTOs and Swagger documentation
features.description:
- Add DTOs: EmailInitiateModel, RefreshModel with class-validator and Swagger decorators.
- Annotate new endpoints with ApiOperation, ApiOkResponse/CreatedResponse as appropriate.
- Ensure confirmation (GET) endpoints return LoginResultModel JSON directly in Swagger.
- Update README and env.example with new config keys.

features.title: Tests and validation
features.description:
- Add unit tests for MagicLinkService, EmailService (mocked), CognitoAdminService (mocked), and controller flows.
- Add config validation tests (missing required keys).
- Add identity linking tests: email uniqueness, linking to correct user.
- Ensure CI passes and coverage is acceptable.

features.title: Cognito JWT auth guard for protected endpoints
features.description:
- Implement a NestJS AuthGuard that validates AWS Cognito JWTs using the user pool JWKS (RS256). Cache and rotate keys automatically.
- Extract claims (sub, cognito:username, email if present) and attach to request context.
- Apply the guard to POST /auth/link/email/initiate (and any future protected auth endpoints).
- Add Swagger bearer auth scheme annotation where applicable.
- Tests: valid/invalid tokens, signature/issuer/audience checks.

features.title: COGNITO_UPDATE.md - Cognito configuration checklist
features.description:
- Add COGNITO_UPDATE.md documenting required Cognito setup:
  - User pool: configure email as username attribute or enable email as an alias to enforce uniqueness.
  - App client: enable USER_PASSWORD_AUTH and REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH flows; set refresh token validity to desired long duration (e.g., 3650 days ~10 years); configure client secret if applicable.
  - Ensure backend IAM permissions for AdminCreateUser, AdminSetUserPassword, AdminUpdateUserAttributes, InitiateAuth, ListUsers.
  - Enable email verification; backend will set email_verified=true on link/login confirmation.
  - SES: verify sender domain/email in the correct region.
  - DynamoDB: create MagicLinkTokens table; enable TTL on 'expiresAt' attribute.
  - Optional: configure a user pool domain for future hosted UI needs.
- Include troubleshooting notes for common errors (USERNAME_EXISTS, alias conflicts, SECRET_HASH mismatch).

features.title: Hosted UI passwordless (OAuth2 code exchange) + remove magic-link/email modules
features.description:
Implementation tasks
- Add endpoint: POST /auth/oauth2/exchange { code, redirectUri, codeVerifier? } → call Cognito oauth2/token (authorization_code) with Authorization: Basic (client_id:client_secret) when configured; include code_verifier. Return LoginResultModel.
- Ensure /auth/refresh uses Cognito oauth2/token (refresh_token) and returns LoginResultModel.
- Implement email linking via Cognito codes:
  - POST /auth/link/email/initiate (JWT): validate uniqueness; set email attr; call GetUserAttributeVerificationCode('email'); return StatusModel { status: 'CODE_SENT' }.
  - POST /auth/link/email/confirm (JWT): body { code }; call VerifyUserAttribute('email', code); ensure UserProfile + link Identities (COGNITO + EMAIL).
- Remove custom magic link login and SES usage from backend:
  - Delete src/auth/magic-link/**/*.
  - Delete src/auth/email-link.controller.ts and src/auth/email-link.controller.spec.ts.
  - Delete src/email/**/*.
  - Update src/auth/auth.module.ts: remove MagicLinkModule and EmailModule imports; remove EmailLinkController.
  - Update src/auth/auth.controller.ts: add /auth/oauth2/exchange and link endpoints (initiate/confirm) as above.
  - Add src/auth/services/cognito-oauth.service.ts to wrap Cognito oauth2/token calls.
- Configuration and validation:
  - Add cognito.domain; require COGNITO_DOMAIN in validation.
  - Make SES_FROM_EMAIL optional; magic-link envs are not required.
- Seed script and docs:
  - Update scripts/seed_database.sh to remove MagicLinkTokens table creation and TTL.
  - Update docs/COGNITO_UPDATE.md to Hosted UI passwordless: domain, authorization code grant, PKCE, scopes, redirect to client app, token exchange via backend.

Notes
- We preserve /auth/anonymous and the admin-only username/password login path for admin flows.
- No Cognito Hosted UI redirect URLs are needed in backend; they are configured in Cognito and used by the client web app.
- JWT guard remains unchanged and will continue to protect link endpoints.
